description: 后翼印度 E15 — Ba6远射象瞄准弱格

intro.popup_en:
Weak Squares, Practice 6: The Long-Range Bishop
Ba6 is a classic example of a long-range bishop. From the a6-f1 diagonal, it targets the weak square c4 from a distance and applies lasting pressure. Identify the opponent's weak squares and let your bishop control them.
intro.popup:
Ba6远射象瞄准弱格 练习6

Ba6是远射象的典型示范
象沿a6-f1对角线直瞄c4弱格
不需要靠近，长期施压！

找出对方的弱格，让象来控制它

outro.popup_en: Summary: Ba6 controls the weak square c4 along the diagonal. The setup ...b6, ...Ba6, and ...c6 forms a complete plan, and Black keeps the bishop's long-range pressure after castling. When playing ...b6, consider whether ...Ba6 can target a weakness.
outro.popup:
远射象练习小结
✅ Ba6沿对角线控制c4弱格
✅ b6+Ba6+c6组成完整攻击体系
✅ O-O后象继续长期守住对角线

练习要点：
推b6时想想Ba6能否攻击弱格

moves.popup_en: d4 controls the center.
moves.popup: d4控制中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops a knight.
moves.popup: Nf6发展马

moves.popup_en: c4 expands on the flank, but c4 itself can become a weak square.
moves.popup:
c4翼侧！
注意：c4本身现在是弱格

moves.popup_en: ...e6 reinforces Black's position.
moves.popup: e6稳固

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops a knight.
moves.popup: Nf3发展马

moves.popup_en: ...b6 prepares either ...Ba6 or ...Bb7, revealing Black's fianchetto plan.
moves.popup:
b6！为Ba6或Bb7做准备
黑方展示翼侧象计划

moves.popup_en: g3 prepares a fianchetto.
moves.popup: g3纤维局

moves.popup_en: ...Ba6! The long-range bishop takes aim at c4 along the a6-f1 diagonal. This is a strategic way to attack a weak square without approaching it directly.
moves.popup:
Ba6！远射象出击
沿a6-f1对角线瞄准c4
这是弱格攻击的远程策略！

moves.popup_en: b3 supports c4 and tries to reduce the bishop's long-term pressure.
moves.popup:
b3守护c4
防止Ba6的持续威胁

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4+ gives check and tests White's response.
moves.popup:
Bb4+将军！
试探白方应对

moves.popup_en: Bd2 blocks with the bishop, avoiding Nd2, which would leave c3 less protected.
moves.popup:
Bd2用象阻截
不用Nd2暴露c3格

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 retreats the bishop to safety.
moves.popup: Be7收象回安全位

moves.popup_en: Bg2 completes White's fianchetto.
moves.popup: Bg2建立纤维局象

moves.popup_en: ...c6 reinforces control of the weak square d5.
moves.popup:
c6加强！
黑方进一步控制d5弱格

moves.popup_en: Bc3! White reinforces c4 by repositioning the bishop to c3.
moves.popup:
Bc3！强化守护c4
白方调整象到c3位

moves.popup_en: ...d5 counterattacks in the center and claims central space.
moves.popup:
d5反击中心！
黑方占领中心

moves.popup_en: Ne5 centralizes the knight on a strong square.
moves.popup:
Ne5中心马！
占据强力位置

moves.popup_en: ...Nfd7 offers an exchange.
moves.popup: Nfd7主动兑换

moves.popup_en: Nxd7 exchanges the knight and removes one of the defenders.
moves.popup:
Nxd7兑换
清除守护马

moves.popup_en: ...Nxd7 recaptures and restores the position.
moves.popup: Nxd7重建

moves.popup_en: Nd2 reorganizes the knight, preparing to move to a better square.
moves.popup:
Nd2重组
马准备跳到更好位置

moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king, but Black's bishop on a6 continues to pressure c4.
moves.popup:
O-O入城
黑方Ba6象继续施压c4！

moves.popup_en: ...O-O completes development for both sides. The structure is clear: Black's bishop on a6 continues to control the weak square c4, demonstrating the power of a long-range bishop.
moves.popup:
O-O双方完成布局
结构清晰：黑象Ba6长期控制c4弱格
这就是远射象策略的威力！
